build_graph_compose: compose two GTN graphs together using gtn.compose to chain transducer automata
build_graph_forward_score: compute the forward score of a GTN graph using gtn.forward_score for log-sum-exp path scoring
build_graph_viterbi_path: find the best Viterbi path through a GTN graph using gtn.viterbi_path for decoding
build_graph_concat: concatenate multiple GTN graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to chain automata
build_graph_remove_epsilon: remove epsilon transitions from a GTN graph using gtn.remove to eliminate empty-symbol arcs
